description: Capture the current page as a screen: real screenshot + serialized DOM (editable, sharp at any zoom) + annotations. Returns the local fidelity score and a picture of how tday.com will render the DOM - check it looks like the app. Write title/description for a marketer: what the screen shows and why it matters.

description.description: What the screen shows, where it sits in the product, the key thing to look at

fromBranch.description: The branch this screen came from when not the current one, e.g. "main" for a before screen

hide.description: CSS selectors to leave out (cookie banners, personal widgets)

key.description: Stable id for recaptures (default: page path + state). Capturing the same key again in this session replaces the earlier one.

keyTarget.description: The element a viewer should look at

name.description: Accessible name (with role) or a form label (alone)

selector.description: CSS selector, last resort. In a demo step, "@x,y" is a point in the window (CSS px; points on a phone) for a canvas with nothing to target

name: capture_screen
title: Capture this screen
